name: Poisson Surface Reconstruction for Mesh Export
definition: A method to export watertight, colored triangle meshes from 3D Gaussians by solving a Poisson equation on an oriented point cloud derived from the Gaussian splats.
summary: Poisson Surface Reconstruction for Mesh Export generates watertight, colored triangle meshes from 3D Gaussians by solving a Poisson equation on an oriented point cloud, ensuring a manifold surface unlike marching cubes.
